title: What If Every Cargo Ship Stopped Sailing?

scenes.text: What if every cargo ship stopped sailing? Most of your life arrives by sea.
More than 90 percent of global trade moves by ship, over 12 billion tonnes a year.
That cargo includes fuel, food, parts and finished goods, with no viable alternative for most of it.
Factories would run out of parts and shops would run short of goods.
The head of the Greek shipowners' union warned the world economy could collapse within 90 days.
It would not take a war. Just a pause in the one network almost nobody sees.

description:
What if every cargo ship stopped?
More than 90 percent of global trade travels by sea, and one shipping leader warns of collapse within 90 days.
What should we run through next?
